The Rise, 275 Montreal Street, Christchurch Central.
Six residences on six levels: a two-bedroom Garden Residence on the ground floor (74.2 m2 gross, private west garden of about 34 m2) and five full-floor three-bedroom residences on Levels 1 to 5 (144.4 m2 gross each, 30 m2 west balcony; the Level 5 penthouse balcony is open to the sky). Ground-floor residents' wellness (70.2 m2: cedar sauna, gym and stretch, garden lounge, spa courtyard). Four car stackers for up to eight cars, subject to design. Discreet north-facing rooftop solar.
Concept design, not yet consented. Marketed by Angela Webb, Bayleys Christchurch, +64 27 349 1997.
